author: homelab
name: SIGMA - Shadow file read via command line (Linux)
description: A process command line referencing /etc/shadow or /etc/gshadow by something other than the standard account tools - catches readers the prebuilt rule misses (e.g. echo piped to ed, T1003.008/4).
false_positives: Backup of /etc; administrator inspecting account files
query: process where event.type == "start" and ((process.command_line like~ ("*/etc/shadow*", "*/etc/gshadow*")) and (not (process.executable like~ ("*/unix_chkpwd", "*/passwd", "*/chage", "*/usermod", "*/useradd", "*/userdel", "*/vipw", "*/newusers", "*/systemd", "*/sshd", "*/chpasswd"))))
